name: SQ8LMPC
author: L'Cronx
summary: SQ8L 0.91b (Ensoniq SQ-80 emulation by Siegfried Kullmann, based on sq8l-revival) on the Akai Force: the same engine and sound, the SQ8L panel on one screen, 168 factory sounds, your own banks with SAVE, and drop-in sound banks. Unofficial, free, non-commercial, for preservation only. The original work belongs to Kullmann and Ensoniq; the port's own code is PolyForm Noncommercial.
